text:
liam: Quick sync 1 sdk v2.1.0 rollout is hitting edge/runtime bundlers. Partner reported Vercel preview fails with ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED when importing @redwood/inference.

sophie: Same as earlier threads but partner says it breaks only when their app uses a subpath import: `@redwood/inference/lib/helpers`.

aditya: That rings a bell. We tightened the exports map and removed main/module fields to be strict about public surface. Exports currently only exposes `.` and a few explicit subpaths. 

liam: Error snippet from reporter: ```Error: Package subpath './lib/helpers' is not defined by "exports" of @redwood/inference
 at new Error (internal/errors.js:...)```

marta: Edge runtimes (Vercel/Cloudflare) and modern bundlers resolve differently. Also some tools ask for ./package.json which we didn't export. That causes `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED` in esbuild in certain configs.

sophie: Quick mitigation proposal: reintroduce backwards-compatible fields and explicit package.json export. Example package.json patch: ```json
{
  "main": "dist/cjs/index.js",
  "module": "dist/esm/index.js",
  "exports": {
    ".": {
      "import": "./dist/esm/index.js",
      "require": "./dist/cjs/index.js"
    },
    "./package.json": "./package.json",
    "./lib/*": "./dist/lib/*.js"
  },
  "types": "dist/types/index.d.ts"
}
```
This keeps conditional exports but adds explicit subpath globs for the internal helpers our samples used.

aditya: I support keeping main/module. Removing them gives neatness but real-world consumers and older Node expect them. Also some packagers still look at module/main before exports.

liam: Can we cut a patch release 2.1.1 with that change? Partner is blocked on onboarding.

marta: I'll open the PR. Also adding a tiny replication test: build sample with Vercel builder and run node14 require() smoke test.

build-bot: created branch fix/exports-compat-1771012345 and ran linters.

aditya: One more note: prefer changing sample apps to import from the public surface only (e.g., `@redwood/inference`), not internal paths. But we can't assume every customer follows that. Exports should be defensive.

sophie: Agreed. Follow-ups: PR for package.json patch (marta), CI matrix for node14/16/18 + vercel preview (aditya), audit sample apps for subpath imports (liam), docs note for migration (sophie).

liam: Filed INF-3723 for CI and INF-3724 for samples audit.

marta: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/412 (includes package.json patch + tiny vercel smoke test). Requesting reviews.

build-bot: ci: added node matrix entry and vercel-preview job (pending secrets).

aditya: After patch lands, let's monitor onboarding flows and announce in changelog: "reverted strict export-only package.json to improve bundler/edge compatibility". Keep an eye on telemetry for client errors.

liam: Thanks team. Let's move fast but no rush on changing sample app imports — those can be follow-up. :thumbsup:
